_comment: SAMPLE AuditCrowd assessor board — FICTIONAL. Always badged 'Sample' in the UI and never presented as your real ZeroBias tasks. It demonstrates the full vision (partition swim-lanes, the task lifecycle, and the economics roll-up) for offline/demo mode. When a real API key is connected, the board pulls the live SmeMartTask records from POST /portal/myTasks instead (badged '● Live'). Boundary ids point at the bundled sample boundaries so clicking a card opens its holographic view.

tasks.name: Verify MFA enforced on all IAM users
tasks.description: Confirm every IAM principal in acme-prod has MFA enabled; flag the deploy-bot and ci-runner service accounts.

tasks.name: KSI: validate centralised logging is enabled
tasks.description: Key Security Indicator — verify CloudTrail plus centralised log aggregation across the checkout boundary.

tasks.name: Assess nginx TLS STIG ciphers
tasks.description: Container STIG nginx-tls is partial-fail; validate the remediation restricts to TLS 1.2+ approved ciphers.

tasks.name: Sign off Q2 attestation
tasks.description: Final reviewer sign-off on the checkout service Q2 boundary snapshot.

tasks.name: Publish 'IAM MFA' guild to the catalog
tasks.description: Prototype, test, validate, review and publish the reusable MFA control as a guild others can buy.

tasks.name: Prototype 'S3 public-access' control
tasks.description: Draft a control that flags S3 buckets whose public-access block is disabled.

tasks.name: Review Azure firewall egress finding
tasks.description: Contoso Azure boundary flagged a critical open egress path; confirm intent or remediate.

tasks.name: Setup connection for Amazon EC2
tasks.description: Stand up the read-only connector so the boundary can be assessed.

tasks.name: Archive evidence & close engagement
tasks.description: Bundle evidence, export the report, and transition the project to COMPLETED.
